notes.title: Version 0.3.0.4 - War themed update
notes.notes:
What is different between v0.3.0.3 and v0.3.0.4 (latest version)?
Well the latest version expands on the war aspect of the game, this includes the following:
- Added a character in the war scene
- Player can move the character with WASD
- Camera follows the player
- Changes to how loading into war works
- Collision with the world borders
- Added Levels (not yet implemented)
- Added Experience (not yet implemented)
- Difficulty has an affect on how often raids happen
- Added Coins that spawn in the war scenes
- Changed textures of the tribesmen
- Added text which includes: Level, coins, difficulty and defence on the war screen
- When towers are destroyed, you lose taken households, leaving empty room in housing for citizens 
The following screenshot is how the war scene now currently looks:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457164/6290f8c365a2d94aa27288e48b358b276b8a3870.png

The next update should drop this weekend!!

notes.title: Version 0.3.0.2
notes.notes:
What is Version 0.3? This version will include the Nations update where you can interact with different nations. Features in the future will include war, trade, interactions and a lot more. 

Over the next few weeks there will small patches of the game if they are stable enough, which will add new features of the Nations Update. We are trying our best to make sure that you do not need to restart your save but don't count us on that. 

What's different from the last version?
Added:
- Hotel Research
- Tourism Requires Hotel Research to be completed
- Tourism requires hotels to be in the nation
- Tourism requires at least one nation to be discovered
- Visible Nations now require certain research before becoming visible
- Added 4 researches for discovering a new nation
- Added a lot more sunshine

Fixes:
- Removed weather symbol from pages that don't need it

Disabled Features:
- Tourism will not work until the next update, which is when hotels will be added.
